* '''Original''' ([[Rogue One (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-rogueoneaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/rogueone_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/rogueone_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Medium Transport”. Text: “May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. May deploy with a pilot to a system without presence or Force Icons. Spies deploy -1 aboard. Immune to attrition < 6 at opponent system (unless a Dark Jedi here).”
